fact_types.knowledge_state: What the student currently knows or does not know about a topic
fact_types.mastered_topic: A topic or skill the student has clearly mastered
fact_types.misconception: A persistent wrong mental model the student holds
fact_types.blocker: Something preventing progress — confusion, missing prerequisite, anxiety
fact_types.learning_style: How the student learns best — visual, example-driven, theory-first, etc.
fact_types.engagement: Motivation level, interests, what engages or disengages them
fact_types.progress_signal: Observable milestone or regression in the learning trajectory
